Name: Safe Scythe
Author: tesserex436
Description:
Have you ever been mowing the grass around your tree farm and accidentally killed your precious fertilized mahogany tree? Well that can now be a thing of the past! This mod's only purpose is to disable this behavior. Melee weapons, which includes the scythe, will no longer destroy those tiny saplings.

As of 1.1, SafeScythe includes a Generic Mod Config Menu, and some options:

[list]
[*]Enable or disable the mod entirely
[*]Limit the protection to only stage 2 or stage 3 saplings
[*]Only protect trees that are fertilized
[*]Also now has the ability to prevent harvesting of flowers.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Safe Scythe
Manifest.Description: Protect your saplings from unwanted trimming.
Manifest.Author: Tesserex
